editorial:
Imagine waking up to find that a scary virus has turned everyone around you into monsters almost overnight. You get to follow one guy who is fighting for his life while filming everything on his camera. The vibe is very lonely and tense, making you feel like you are right there with him as he tries to survive in a world that has completely fallen apart. It feels like a homemade nightmare where you never know what is waiting around the next corner, and the mystery of why he is still alive keeps you glued to the screen.

What really works here is how the movie uses found footage to make the horror feel real. The acting is natural, and the pacing keeps things moving so you don't get bored. While some of the special effects look a bit cheap, the tension makes up for it. If you love survival stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that the man was not just lucky, but his blood actually holds the key to the cure. After a long struggle to stay alive, the CDC finally recovers his footage and finds his location. However, the twist is that the process of saving the world requires a sacrifice. He ends up giving everything he has left to help the doctors, providing the final piece of the puzzle to stop the virus.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie movies and found footage horror.
